# Vedansh

> A free, ad-free, fully offline mobile app for daily Hindu devotion: sacred texts
> in a book-like reader, a daily Panchang computed from an astronomy engine, daily
> routines and Sankalp programmes, a japam bead counter, and a Theerth pilgrimage
> map. Available for iOS and Android. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Vedansh reads in Hindi (Devanagari) and English, with Gujarati and Kannada also
available as reading languages; Sanskrit texts additionally show IAST
transliteration. Everything — texts, audio and the panchang engine — ships inside
the app, so it works with no network. The app reaches the network only to check
for an update.

## What it contains

- **Sacred library**: all eighteen chapters and 701 shlokas of the Bhagavad Gita
  with meaning and commentary; Sundarkand and Ramcharitmanas selections; Vishnu
  Sahasranama; chalisas, aartis and stotrams.
- **Panchang**: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and sunrise computed from an
  astronomy engine rather than a lookup table. Purnimant and Amanta month
  systems, Vikram Samvat, and a full month calendar. Timings are computed for the
  user's city; Ujjain is the default.
- **Muhurat**: choghadiya through the day, including Rahu Kaal and Abhijit.
- **Sadhana**: daily or weekday routines with the deity for each day, and Sankalp
  programmes running four to forty-one days.
- **Japam**: a bead counter with alarms.
- **Theerth**: a pilgrimage map of temples across India, with each temple's story.

## Privacy

No account exists and no personal data is collected — no analytics, no ads, no
tracking. Location is optional, used only to compute accurate sunrise, sunset and
Panchang timings, and the coordinates never leave the device. Bookmarks, reading
progress, routines, Sankalp programmes, japam counts and streaks live only on the
device; uninstalling the app removes all of it, and there is nothing on a server
to request deletion of.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vedansh.app/): what the app does, with screenshots of each area.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vedansh.app/privacy/): what is collected (nothing) and why location is optional.
- [Terms of Use](https://vedansh.app/terms/): public-domain texts offered for personal study and devotion, as-is.
- [Support](https://vedansh.app/support/): common questions, japam alarm troubleshooting, reporting a verse correction, and how to reach a human.
